lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately seven vertical columns of high-luminance circular blobs are visible posterior to the gill slits. The spatial distribution follows a grid-like arrangement where the horizontal distance between columns increases slightly toward the posterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the columns of high-luminance blobs, creating a rectilinear pattern of high-intensity anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light pixel values on the superior side and a dark shadow on the inferior side.

other_distinctive_markers: A unique labyrinthine or maze-like configuration of high-luminance lines is present in the transitional zone between the posterior gill slit and the first organized vertical column of spots. Multiple remoras are visible attached to the ventral-lateral surface.
